# Test fixtures

Every file here is **synthetic**. The JSON *structure* (field names, Solr-style single-element
arrays, `Z`-suffixed IST timestamps) mirrors what the GeM `all-bids-data` endpoint returned during the
2026-10-17 feasibility inspection, but all values — ids, bid numbers, titles, organisations, dates —
are invented. They must never be loaded into a real database or presented as GeM data.
